sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors like Real Estate and Healthcare are showing robust all-green breadth and upward rank momentum, while high-momentum leaders Technology and Industrials are starting to slip.

A rotation is underway as defensive and value-oriented sectors assert dominance. Currently, 4 of 11 groups have achieved "all-green" status, showing positive performance across all timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD). Real Estate (momentum 0.70) and Healthcare (momentum 0.63) are leading this charge, both gaining ground in rank alongside a surging Energy sector, which jumped 2 spots to claim the top year-to-date rank with a momentum score of 0.57.

Conversely, former market leaders are showing signs of near-term exhaustion. While Industrials (0.70) and Technology (0.68) still boast high absolute momentum scores, both sectors slipped 1 rank over the last five sessions. Growth is fading elsewhere too, with Communication Services dropping 2 spots to rank 10 with a weak 0.22 momentum score, and Consumer Cyclical remaining anchored at the bottom of the board (rank 11, momentum 0.15).

## Strength
* **Broad Breadth:** 4 out of 11 sectors—Real Estate, Healthcare, Financials, and Utilities—are currently "all-green," signaling positive performance across all measured timeframes.
* **Real Estate Surging:** Real Estate holds all-green status with a top-tier momentum score of 0.70, climbing 1 spot to rank 4.
* **Defensive Anchors:** Healthcare (momentum 0.63, rank 8) and Utilities (momentum 0.47, rank 7) maintain all-green profiles, with Healthcare gaining 2 rank spots over the last 5 sessions.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Energy Takes the Lead:** Energy improved by 2 spots over the last 5 sessions to secure the number 1 YTD rank, carrying a momentum score of 0.57.
* **Communication Services Slumping:** The sector fell 2 spots to rank 10, with momentum deteriorating to 0.22.
* **Persistent Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical remains the weakest sector in the market, stuck at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.15.

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Despite high momentum scores, Industrials (0.70, rank 3) and Technology (0.68, rank 2) each slipped 1 spot in rank over the last 5 days, signaling a near-term cooling.
* **Fragile All-Green Signals:** Financials (agreement 0.38) and Healthcare (agreement 0.39) exhibit low agreement scores, suggesting their all-green status rests on unstable ranking trends.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Robust market breadth is anchored by heavy machinery, textiles, and healthcare plans (41 of 144 groups all-green), while solar and tech-related internet content suffer sharp weekly rotations.

US industry groups show solid underlying health as of June 26, 2026, with 41 of 144 groups maintaining "all-green" status (positive across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD horizons). Strong momentum is concentrated in Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.88), Textile Manufacturing (0.87), and Healthcare Plans (0.87). Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors are rotating higher, highlighted by rapid rank improvements in Drug Manufacturers - General (+23 spots) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (+22 spots).

Conversely, high-profile growth and commodity-linked groups are fading. Solar (-41 spots), Aerospace & Defense (-34 spots), and Internet Content & Information (-34 spots) experienced the sharpest weekly declines. Early-warning signals also show momentum fading in bellwethers like Semiconductors (rank -8) and Diversified Banks (rank -6), while defensive laggards like Waste Management and Insurance Brokers are beginning to emerge.

## Strength
* **Broad Breadth:** 41 out of 144 industry groups maintain an all-green status, showing positive performance across all timeframes from one week to YTD.
* **Sustained Leaders:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (momentum 0.88) and Textile Manufacturing (momentum 0.87) remain top performers across all multi-month ranks.
* **Real Estate & Healthcare Strength:** REITs (Hotel & Motel at 0.85, Healthcare Facilities at 0.78, and Retail at 0.77) alongside Healthcare Plans (0.87) demonstrate robust, multi-period positive momentum.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Drug Manufacturers - General and Utilities - Regulated Water both surged +23 spots in rank (to 59 and 48 respectively), followed closely by REIT - Healthcare Facilities (+22 spots to rank 36, momentum 0.78) and Airlines (+21 spots to rank 46, momentum 0.85).
* **Top Losers:** Solar plunged -41 spots to rank 91 (momentum 0.34), while Aerospace & Defense (-34 spots to rank 77) and Internet Content & Information (-34 spots to rank 98) also saw significant weekly pullbacks.
* **Momentum Extremes:** Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery leads all groups with a momentum score of 0.878 (YTD rank 6), while Pharmaceutical Retailers sits at the absolute bottom with a score of 0.066 (YTD rank 144).

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Despite solid momentum, several key groups are slipping in rank, including Semiconductors (momentum 0.68, down 8 spots) and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, down 6 spots).
* **Emerging Laggards:** Waste Management (+15 spots, momentum 0.50) and Insurance Brokers (+12 spots, momentum 0.40) are jumping in rank despite currently low momentum scores.
* **Fragile All-Green:** Department Stores holds an all-green status but displays low stability with an agreement score of only 0.48.
